column1: # Text ranges: every byte of every overlay's text, and nothing else.
#   file `*` = the shared block: the same bytes in all eight SYO00-07 overlays,
#        translated once and written eight times (tools/extract.py proves the copies match).
#   region common  = menu / SAVE / LOAD / memory-card text (shared block)
#          names   = the character name table (shared block)
#          prompt  = pieces the code joins to a name at runtime (shared block)
#          script  = the chapter's dialogue, in one packed block after the overlay's code
#          bark    = a battle bark embedded between script records (declare each string)
#          block   = a text area interleaved with record bytes; the extractor skips everything
#                    that is not a whole string and reports how much it skipped. Write it as
#                    "block+<tag>" (e.g. block+numbers) so the entries keep their own region.
#          debug   = internal labels (fullwidth Latin, already readable; not player text)
#          numbers = a table of fullwidth numerals the engine prints (no translation)
#          battle  = a string BATTLE.BIN sends to a text window
#          memcard = the save title the BIOS memory-card screen draws: Shift-JIS only, 64-byte field
#          data    = bytes that are NOT text to translate (loader paths, tables, sentinels)
# Ends are one past the last string's NUL. Proven: tools/extract.py --check walks every range,
# every byte of every text region is covered by a string, and no text is found outside them.
# --- shared block (identical in all 8 overlays; phase 1 notes said 0x00C-0x8AE) ---
